title: Periosteal Envelope Flap as a Technique for Horizontal Bone Augmentation: A Case Series Study
authors: Arab S, Reza Arab H, Aghaloo M, Shiezadeh F, Tajik S, Moeintaghavi A. The Open Dentistry Journal 2018; 12. 995-1003.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The authors concluded that the periosteal pocket flap in conjunction with GBR is a suitable technique to increase the width of the alveolar ridge” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
